result.instructions: Tools for Onfido, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Onfido data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run onfido_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run onfido_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run onfido_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. onfido_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: onfido_list_applicants
tools.title: List applicants
tools.description: List applicant (person) records in the Onfido account, paginated. Onfido API: GET /applicants.

include_deleted.description: Include applicants scheduled for deletion. Default false.

tools.name: onfido_get_applicant
tools.title: Get applicant
tools.description: Retrieve a single applicant record by id. Onfido API: GET /applicants/{applicant_id}.

tools.name: onfido_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List the identity documents uploaded for an applicant (metadata only). Onfido API: GET /documents?applicant_id=….

applicant_id.description: The applicant id whose documents to list (required).

tools.name: onfido_get_document
tools.title: Get document
tools.description: Retrieve a single document's metadata by id. Onfido API: GET /documents/{document_id}.

tools.name: onfido_list_checks
tools.title: List checks
tools.description: List the verification checks run for an applicant (results/status, read-only). Onfido API: GET /checks?applicant_id=….

applicant_id.description: The applicant id whose checks to list (required).

tools.name: onfido_get_check
tools.title: Get check
tools.description: Retrieve a single check (status + report ids + result) by id. Onfido API: GET /checks/{check_id}.

tools.name: onfido_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the individual reports that make up a check (document, facial similarity, watchlist, …). Onfido API: GET /reports?check_id=….

check_id.description: The check id whose reports to list (required).

tools.name: onfido_get_report
tools.title: Get report
tools.description: Retrieve a single report (detailed breakdown + result) by id. Onfido API: GET /reports/{report_id}.

tools.name: onfido_list_workflow_runs
tools.title: List workflow runs
tools.description: List Onfido Studio workflow runs (status/output, read-only — does NOT start a run). Onfido API: GET /workflow_runs.

status.description: Filter by status, e.g. processing | awaiting_input | approved | declined | abandoned | error.

applicant_id.description: Filter to a single applicant's workflow runs.

sort.description: Sort by creation time. Default desc.

created_at_gt.description: Only runs created after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

created_at_lt.description: Only runs created before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

tools.name: onfido_get_workflow_run
tools.title: Get workflow run
tools.description: Retrieve a single Studio workflow run (status, output, task history) by id. Onfido API: GET /workflow_runs/{workflow_run_id}.

tools.name: onfido_list_live_photos
tools.title: List live photos
tools.description: List the live photos captured for an applicant (metadata only). Onfido API: GET /live_photos?applicant_id=….

applicant_id.description: The applicant id whose live photos to list (required).

tools.name: onfido_list_live_videos
tools.title: List live videos
tools.description: List the live videos captured for an applicant (metadata only). Onfido API: GET /live_videos?applicant_id=….

applicant_id.description: The applicant id whose live videos to list (required).

tools.name: onfido_create_applicant
tools.title: Create applicant
tools.description: Creates an applicant (person) record in Onfido. Onfido API: POST /applicants. Creates a PII record only — runs NO verification check and costs nothing.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 or local format.

address.description: Address object (building_number, street, town, postcode, country, …). Passed through as-is.

id_numbers.description: Array of id-number objects ({ type, value, state_code? }). Passed through as-is.

location.description: Location object (ip_address, country_of_residence, …) for consent tracking. Passed through as-is.

tools.name: onfido_update_applicant
tools.title: Update applicant
tools.description: Updates an applicant's details (reversible; runs no verification). Onfido API: PUT /applicants/{applicant_id}.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 or local format.

address.description: Address object (building_number, street, town, postcode, country, …). Passed through as-is.

id_numbers.description: Array of id-number objects ({ type, value, state_code? }). Passed through as-is.
